{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module LogAgent where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, forM_)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.Directory (doesFileExist, doesDirectoryExist, createDirectoryIfMissing, getFileSize)
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeDirectory, normalise, splitDirectories, isAbsolute, isPathSeparator)
import System.IO (Handle, hPutStrLn, hFlush, hClose, stderr)
import System.Posix.Files (getSymbolicLinkStatus, isRegularFile, isSymbolicLink, fileMode, FileStatus)
import System.Posix.IO (openFd, defaultFileFlags, OpenMode(..), fdToHandle, OpenFileFlags(..))
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)

data PoolConfig = PoolConfig
  { poolMaxConns   :: Int
  , poolLogDir     :: FilePath
  , poolRotateSize :: Integer
  , poolCheckInterval :: Int
  }

data LogConn = LogConn
  { connHandle   :: Handle
  , connPath     :: FilePath
  , connCreated  :: UTCTime
  , connBytes    :: IORef Integer
  }

data ConnPool = ConnPool
  { poolConns  :: MVar (Map.Map String LogConn)
  , poolConfig :: PoolConfig
  }

defaultConfig :: PoolConfig
defaultConfig = PoolConfig 10 "/var/log/agent" (10 * 1024 * 1024) 30

-- | Validates that a path is within the allowed log directory
-- Uses canonical path resolution to prevent directory traversal.
-- normalise in System.FilePath does NOT collapse or reject "..", so we
-- must explicitly reject absolute paths, path-separator-injecting names,
-- and any component that is ".." (parent traversal) before trusting the
-- prefix comparison.
validateLogPath :: FilePath -> FilePath -> IO Bool
validateLogPath baseDir requestedPath = do
  let normalPath = normalise requestedPath
      fullPath = baseDir </> normalPath
      resolvedBase = normalise baseDir
      components = splitDirectories normalPath
      hasTraversal = any (== "..") components
      absolute = isAbsolute requestedPath
  -- Reject absolute paths and any parent-directory traversal outright.
  if absolute || hasTraversal
    then return False
    else return $ resolvedBase `isPrefixOf` (normalise fullPath)

-- | Reject connection identifiers that could be used to escape the log
-- directory (path separators or parent traversal sequences).
validConnId :: String -> Bool
validConnId connId =
  not (null connId)
    && not (any isPathSeparator connId)
    && not (".." `isPrefixOf` connId)
    && ".." `notElem` splitDirectories connId

-- | Check if path is safe - verifies it's a regular file, not a symlink
-- This is the security gate for file operations
checkPathSafety :: FilePath -> IO Bool
checkPathSafety path = do
  exists <- doesFileExist path
  if not exists
    then return True  -- New file, will be created safely
    else do
      status <- getSymbolicLinkStatus path
      return $ isRegularFile status && not (isSymbolicLink status)

-- | Rotate log file if it exceeds size threshold
rotateIfNeeded :: ConnPool -> String -> LogConn -> IO (Maybe LogConn)
rotateIfNeeded pool connId conn = do
  currentBytes <- readIORef (connBytes conn)
  if currentBytes >= poolRotateSize (poolConfig pool)
    then do
      hClose (connHandle conn)
      let newPath = connPath conn ++ ".rotated"
      -- Verify safety before rotation
      safe <- checkPathSafety newPath
      if safe
        then do
          newConn <- openLogConn (poolConfig pool) connId
          return (Just newConn)
        else do
          hPutStrLn stderr $ "Unsafe rotation target: " ++ newPath
          return Nothing
    else return (Just conn)

-- | Open a new log connection with atomic safety guarantees
-- Uses O_NOFOLLOW to atomically reject symlinks at open time
openLogConn :: PoolConfig -> String -> IO LogConn
openLogConn config connId = do
  -- Reject dangerous connection identifiers before any path is built.
  unless (validConnId connId) $ error $ "Invalid connection id: " ++ connId
  let logPath = poolLogDir config </> connId ++ ".log"
  -- Validate the path is within bounds
  valid <- validateLogPath (poolLogDir config) (connId ++ ".log")
  unless valid $ error $ "Path validation failed for: " ++ connId
  -- Ensure directory exists
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (takeDirectory logPath)
  -- Use O_NOFOLLOW to atomically prevent symlink following
  -- This eliminates the TOCTOU window between check and open
  let flags = defaultFileFlags { noFollow = True, append = True }
  fd <- openFd logPath WriteOnly (Just 0o640) flags
  handle <- fdToHandle fd
  -- Post-open verification: confirm the opened fd points to a regular file
  status <- getSymbolicLinkStatus logPath
  unless (isRegularFile status) $ do
    hClose handle
    error $ "Opened path is not a regular file: " ++ logPath
  now <- getCurrentTime
  bytesRef <- newIORef 0
  return $ LogConn handle logPath now bytesRef

-- | Write a log entry through the connection pool
writeLog :: ConnPool -> String -> String -> IO ()
writeLog pool connId msg = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  conn <- case Map.lookup connId conns of
    Just c  -> return c
    Nothing -> openLogConn (poolConfig pool) connId
  -- Check rotation
  mConn <- rotateIfNeeded pool connId conn
  case mConn of
    Nothing -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) (Map.delete connId conns)
      hPutStrLn stderr "Connection removed due to safety violation"
    Just activeConn -> do
      hPutStrLn (connHandle activeConn) msg
      hFlush (connHandle activeConn)
      modifyIORef' (connBytes activeConn) (+ fromIntegral (length msg + 1))
      putMVar (poolConns pool) (Map.insert connId activeConn conns)

-- | Initialize the connection pool
initPool :: PoolConfig -> IO ConnPool
initPool config = do
  createDirectoryIfMissing True (poolLogDir config)
  connsVar <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ ConnPool connsVar config

-- | Background health checker - periodically validates connections
healthChecker :: ConnPool -> IO ()
healthChecker pool = forever $ do
  threadDelay (poolCheckInterval (poolConfig pool) * 1000000)
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  validConns <- Map.traverseWithKey (\k conn -> do
    safe <- checkPathSafety (connPath conn)
    if safe
      then return (Just conn)
      else do
        hClose (connHandle conn)
        hPutStrLn stderr $ "Closing unsafe connection: " ++ k
        return Nothing
    ) conns
  let cleaned = Map.mapMaybe id validConns
  putMVar (poolConns pool) cleaned

-- | Main entry point for the logging agent
startAgent :: PoolConfig -> IO ConnPool
startAgent config = do
  pool <- initPool config
  _ <- forkIO $ healthChecker pool
  return pool
